## DeskHelper Pro 1.3.13
**New** - **Per-app volume boost** — Audio Mixer sliders now go up to **200%**, so you can push a quiet app (like a low YouTube video) toward full loudness. 100% is the app's own volume; boosted audio is clip-protected.
**Improvements** - **Active Window Highlight** — the outline now hides while a file picker or modal panel covers the focused window (including TestFlight and other iPad-style apps), instead of drawing a stray border underneath it.
